{{Quote|This isn't the Empire, son.|The Mon Calamari technician, to Penn Pershing|<ref name="Chapter 19" />}}
A [[Mon Calamari]] '''technician''' worked on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. They were part of the team that strapped [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] to a [[Six-O-Two Mitigator]]. The technician tried to comfort Pershing, visibly distraught<ref name="Chapter 19" /> due to the device being a type of [[Mind Flayer]],<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|222|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Three Companion}}</ref> claiming the device had also been used on them earlier. The technician and the rest of the staff left the room while Pershing underwent the treatment, allowing [[Elia Kane]] to raise the intensity without the staff's knowledge.<ref name="Chapter 19" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari technician appeared in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]]. [[Norwood Cheek]] portrayed the character, John Ott did the ADR.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
